History and documentary records

The supplied documents record the state registration of a religious organisation in the village of Kybliary, Zakarpattia region.

Name in the documents

Релігійна організація «Православна релігійна громада Апостольської традиції “Вишукування загиблих”»

State registration
20 May 2005
Legal entity identification code
33760792
Locality
Kybliary, Zakarpattia, Ukraine

The supplied certificate identifies the legal form as a religious organisation. These historical documents do not establish the current leadership or present ecclesiastical jurisdiction.

The beginning in the records

12.03.2005

Order No. 1, dated 20 May 2005, refers to the minutes of a general meeting of members held on 12 March 2005. This is a documentary reference to the meeting; the minutes themselves were not included in the supplied materials.

20.05.2005

The state registration certificate and the extract from the Unified State Register give the state registration date as 20 May 2005.
